test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 28 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: 10 men can complete a work in 12 days, and 10 women can complete the same work in 6 days. How many days will it take to complete the work if they work together?
solution:
**Given:**

10 men can complete a work = 12 days

10 women can complete the same work = 6 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = efficiency × time

M1 × D1 = M2 × D2

Where, M1 = M2 = Number of workers,

D1 = D2 = Days to complete the work

**Calculation:**

⇒ 10M × 12 = 10W × 6

⇒ M/W = 1/2

Total work = (10 × 1) × 12 = 120

Time taken to complete the work together = 120/(3 × 10) = 4 days

**∴ It will take 4 days to complete the work if they work together.**
